name: CUT valuePreservationByRemoveLP pays compensation at the live PancakeSwap spot price
summary: On LP removal CUT credits the remover extra CUT so the position keeps the USDT value recorded when it was added; its deal-type logic contract computes both values from the USDT/CUT pair's spot reserves. The attacker pumped CUT, added liquidity, dumped CUT, then removed the liquidity for a large CUT credit and sold it for the pair's USDT.
notes: The deal-type contract has no upgrade path, but CUT reached it only after the owner's settransferFunDealTypeContractAddress repointed slot 0x12 to it, so that call is the reset (rule 9). CUT, which credits the computed amount, is listed with its own deployment. The price module set later in registry 0x0917914b is not read by the valuation.

Campaign: the only pair Burn events that occur several times in one transaction are these four, all from the attacker contract 0x87efb39a; later single removals by ordinary LPs are the mechanism working as designed on their own recorded positions and are not counted.
The deal-type contract is unverified; its use of spot reserves is read from the anchor trace (getReserves inside valuePreservationByRemoveLP and the LP-add registration).
